title: The chain
notes: The roots hang on real chains: each slab on two chains hooked where you caught it, its weight where you put it. Slabs knock the rock.
The drill is the stake: every true catch sinks it a step into the opening; at the limit it tears through the floor.
From Depth 3 the Dark's claws burst from the walls and shove the chain; from Depth 4 it strikes the rock.
